title: manifest — rich per-run context carried across stages (stub, provenance; authoritative model = src/programsmith/manifest.py)
description: Single source of truth for context. Cells append validated blobs; gates read pure functions over this. Amended by ADR-0038 (ProgramBench dimensions + oracle bundle) — legacy rewrite-port fields stay OPTIONAL so old manifests load.

copyleft_blocked.description: true => reference port must be clean-room (ADR-0010)

cli_entrypoint.description: path/marker that established the executable entrypoint

dimensions._comment: ADR-0038: the ProgramBench axes (from the selected TaskCandidate — pydantic in cells/task_matrix.py is the real contract). No required list: NEW manifests carry the ProgramBench fields, LEGACY manifests carry the rewrite-port fields; both must load.

tool_name.description: binary name agents must reimplement (may differ from repo name)

binary_name.description: actual executable name (e.g. difft for difftastic)

flag_surface.description: which subcommands/flags the grader will exercise (the scope; hashed into task_identity)

case_families.description: feature families the case suite must cover (15-30 cases each)

stdin_friendly.description: verifier pipes stdin; file-walking tools need files_dir cases

verifier_mechanism.description: LEGACY — ProgramBench grading is always byte-exact golden-I/O

oracle._comment: ADR-0038: the ORACLE_GOLDEN output bundle (oracle pair + docs + case suite + fixtures). Legacy reference-port/epsilon fields kept optional for old runs.

text_distinct.description: assert_text_distinct passed — oracle vs prebuilt binaries are byte-distinct

epsilon.description: LEGACY — ProgramBench grading is byte-exact; kept for old rewrite manifests

network_policy.description: ADR-0009 — three distinct policies (unchanged by the pivot)

run_config.description: per-run sweep config (ADR-0032) — agents/bands per stage; wins over built-in defaults

source_screen.description: deterministic pre-model source eligibility result for the active profile

sweeps._comment: keys 'difficulty' (= SMOKE, GLM) and 'full' (= FRONTIER, Opus) are persisted names — NEVER renamed (design non-goal)

outbox.description: ADR-0039 export record (replaces the PR record)

snapshot.description: frozen CI checks + templates used by this run (reproducibility)

pass_at_1.description: aggregate over groups (ADR-0040; dual-family fields only when present)

smoke_saturated.description: CALIBRATE: GLM 3/3 but too-easy-to-harden — proceeded anyway; opus decides the shelf (ADR-0040)

goodfail.description: cached GoodFailReport + gate verdict (ADR-0041; frontier only, once per generation)

hard_keep.description: frontier zero/low-pass kept — trajectory-verified capability headroom (ADR-0041); QA_GATE accepts
